actions.action: Mix about 3 ml shampoo into 1 liter of water in a pump sprayer or a spray bottle
Spray the shampoo solution over and under the leaves and on the stems in the evening, repeating within the week if needed
Rinse the solution off the plant with plain water the next morning, before noon
Check the undersides of leaves and the stems to see whether the bugs have reduced
Optionally use an organic shampoo instead of a regular one

verdict.reason: The answer is a generic mealybug video (aphids come up only in passing), so the diagnosis is wrong; its shampoo spray followed by a plain-water rinse would likely still control aphids and partly matches the rinsing fix; the dilute, rinsed-off spray is not likely to harm the plant.
